expectations.text: Produces exactly four Socratic prompts, one per documentation facet
expectations.evidence: Four prompts: getting-started, troubleshooting, command reference, README intro.

expectations.text: Each prompt contains theory + framework + application moves
expectations.evidence: Each uses explicit THEORY / FRAMEWORK / APPLICATION / CRITIQUE labels.

Names 'time-to-first-success' as a principle; however mostly instructs the model to 'list the 4-6 properties' itself rather than naming established frameworks (no Diátaxis / inverted pyramid / Nielsen by name).

expectations.text: Theory questions target effectiveness, not 'what is'
expectations.evidence: e.g. asks for the single 'it works!' moment and what separates excellent from mediocre.

expectations.text: Output is prompts, not actual documentation prose
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is four prompt code-blocks; no docs written.
Ends with a 'How to get the most out of these' tips section — no reusable theory→framework→application skeleton the user can re-apply.
